LanguageData.AdvancedRimTalk.Settings.EmbedArtiIntoRi: Embed Arti into the existing RimTalk prompt
Keep RimTalk's presets, message roles, chat history, and assembler. Evaluate {{% ... %}} Arti blocks when an existing prompt entry is rendered.
LanguageData.AdvancedRimTalk.Settings.TakeoverRimTalk: Advanced RimTalk takes over the RimTalk prompt
Build the system and user messages from the takeover Arti document. RimTalk still handles triggers, model clients, and responses.
LanguageData.AdvancedRimTalk.Settings.EnablePlacehold: In embed mode, expand Advanced RimTalk placeholders when a prompt is generated.
LanguageData.AdvancedRimTalk.Settings.TakeoverArtiPro: Only {{% ... %}} Arti blocks execute here. Other text becomes the system message.
LanguageData.AdvancedRimTalk.Settings.ReplaceRimTalkP: Build request messages with Advanced RimTalk instead of RimTalk presets and Scriban rendering. RimTalk still handles triggers and the model client.
